editorial.blurb: Bawarchi serves authentic Hyderabadi cuisine with the warmth of home cooking—crispy dosas, fragrant biryanis, and perfectly spiced curries that transport you straight to India.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Bagara Khana with Dalcha or go for the Mix Combo Platter ($13.99) for a complete flavor journey; arrive during off-peak hours to fully appreciate the intimate, homely vibe.
